sloka: त्रिशंकुः इति विख्यात इक्ष्वाकु कुल वर्धनः ।तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना यजेयम् इति राघव ॥१-५७-११॥
transliteration: triśaṁkuḥ iti vikhyāta ikṣvāku kula vardhanaḥ ।tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā yajeyam iti rāghava ॥1-57-11॥

translations.english: "O Rama seeing him in the form of a chandala, all his counsellors, inhabitants of the city including his followers fled away.
